question: Over the frozen open-development commit sample, does one relation.changed_public_callee@1 obligation's context.subject_windows@3 inventory increase usable source-grounded disposition completion beyond a byte-identical shared change-evidence core containing the complete profile-defined base/head production diff and selected changed callee implementation, for the same model under the same 65536-byte admitted-source ceiling and common requested backend settings?
authority_ceiling: descriptive frozen-corpus evaluation only; no claim, judge result, or completion is verified, human-accepted, or defect truth

corpus.selection: eligible repositories sorted by SHA-256(repository_selection seed + NUL + canonical repository ID), then ID; take first three without substitution
corpus.history: resolved HEAD, first-parent chain; each analysis unit is first_parent(commit)->commit

analysis.sample: one label-independent hash order over all model-eligible clusters; Stage 1 first 10, Stage 2A first 40 cumulative
analysis.repository_reporting: publish overall, each repository, and three leave-one-repository-out cells
analysis.estimand: (B-only completion - A-only completion) / paired commit clusters
analysis.inferential_claims: none; no m20 p-value, alpha, confidence interval, significance, population power, or general Rust effect

common.reasoning_effort_request_rule: omit the reasoning_effort field; any explicit low, high, xhigh, or other override is a prelaunch refusal
common.input_token_policy: no evaluator-enforced input-token ceiling or tokenizer preflight; backend tokenizer and usage data are observation-only and never affect eligibility, ordering, scoring, failure codes, or decisions
common.output_budget_status: retained after the excluded nonregistered corrected pilot: 1/6 primary completions at 12000 and 5/12 responses reaching 32000 do not supply a preregistered rule for choosing a new cap; budget terminals remain primary zero, and a higher-budget question requires a new versioned experiment
common.budget_meaning: equal input budget is enforced only by applying admitted_source_bytes <= 65536 to each complete arm packet; packets are not padded; this is not equality of tokens, information, serialized request bytes, or cost
common.byte_ceiling_terminal: if either arm is 65537 bytes or more, the pair is sealed as model_ineligible with reason admitted_source_byte_ceiling_exceeded, null arm results, zero reviewer/judge calls, CLI exit 0, and no membership in n/b/c/n00
common.budget_boundary_fixtures: both arms exactly 65536 bytes pass; changing one arm to 65537 bytes yields the sealed pair-wide model_ineligible terminal result and no primary record

arms.A: exactly the shared change-evidence core, encoded with the common visible contract and no D metadata
arms.B: the byte-identical shared change-evidence core union one selected D obligation's bounded subject-window source bytes, encoded with the same visible contract; D metadata exists only in the hidden binding
arms.order: low bit of SHA-256(arm_order seed + NUL + commit_cluster_id): 0=A then B, 1=B then A

role_separation.freeze_order: one atomic coordinated freeze of occurrence-summary closure and context.subject_windows@3, together with the single-pipeline evaluator, schemas, vectors, generated fixtures, attacks, and hashes, before any Stage 0/model observation or corpus resolution; no occurrence-only intermediate freeze

prose_retains: question, authority ceiling, corpus, analysis unit, sample order
seven Stage 0 gates and exact set boundaries
descriptive rectangles, budgets, control timing, sealing order, interpretation limits
executable_bundle_owns_exclusively: source excerpt extraction, payload closure, packet construction, and reviewer-lens scan
undecidable-question registry, loss derivation, and paired abstention opportunity
two-candidate judge batch construction, permutation, validation, and reconciliation
primary conjunction, ordered failure codes, full-run artifact generation, and attack behavior
one production run from authenticated repository/commit/obligation selectors with no intermediate artifact inputs
exact internal occurrence-set rebuild into per-file summaries/report/coverage commitments and per-cluster resource metrics
context.subject_windows@3 four-denominator rebuild, subject-first materialization, exact anchor partition, latent union, and projection hash
Option C independent accepted/reached/support-anchor reconstruction, production replay comparison, semantic mutants, and pre-seal measurements
one model-free Stage 0 production entry that owns corpus enumeration, 300-cluster completeness, two clean builds, seven-gate reduction, and exact Stage 1/2A selection
normative_boundary.no_duplicate_algorithm_rule: The four prose documents may state outcomes and authority but must not restate executable algorithms. EVALUATOR_SPEC.md governs implementation until non-null freeze hashes bind the evaluator bundle.
normative_boundary.trust_boundary: Only raw reviewer and judge invocation results cross into scoring as untrusted values. Packet, loss, binding, opportunity, candidate, batch, and primary values are private in-process constructions and written artifacts are never production inputs.

source_body_contract.outcome: Every admitted source closes to directly reviewer-readable strict-UTF-8 excerpt text in a closed content-addressed payload table; UTF8(text), byte length, and hashes must agree. Payload text and exact normalized repository paths are the only lens-scan exceptions.

shared_change_evidence_contract.design_section: ADR 0038 section 8.2; the next atomic seal must update EVALUATOR_SPEC.md, schemas, vectors, attacks, and hashes before use
shared_change_evidence_contract.basis: the complete profile-defined base/head production-diff inventory from the frozen baseline planner plus the selected changed public callee's exact complete head implementation range
shared_change_evidence_contract.symmetry: the normalized source records and payloads are byte-identical in A and B; they use only generic visible roles and reveal no D binding
shared_change_evidence_contract.arm_unions: A is exactly the shared core; B adds context.subject_windows@3 admitted sources; exact duplicate keys/payloads are serialized once and conflicts are invalid
shared_change_evidence_contract.budget_and_loss: each complete union independently satisfies <=65536 admitted source bytes without padding or truncation; inability to derive or close mandatory common evidence is the same typed task-blocking source/reference loss in both arms and is never silent
shared_change_evidence_contract.estimand_effect: the treatment contrast is subject-window context beyond a common task/change basis, not diff-aware versus change-blind review
shared_change_evidence_contract.stage0_effect: C/A/S/D sets and seven gate definitions are unchanged, but packet byte counts, model eligibility, and Stage 1 selection can change; Stage 0 must be rerun under the new seal and earlier Stage 0 output is not reusable

abstention_opportunity_contract.outcome: Availability is derived only from pinned repository lookup plus EXTRACT; no status input exists. Eligibility is constructed by a closed total registry and can contribute only under equal paired question/reason signatures.

text_and_scorer_contract.outcome: Hash-bound code and reference vectors exclusively decide normalization, mechanical predicates, failure ordering, and completion.

judge_batch_contract.outcome: One in-process arm-hidden batch contains two opaque co-derived candidates and returns one independent score for each; the in-memory sealed permutation restores arms without rereading its artifact.

reference_vectors.original_52_rule: The original 52 rows and order are byte-for-byte unchanged; 22 static literals cover occurrence, context v3, Option C identity/source/measurement/mutant bindings, freeze history, and the three-input execution formula.
reference_vectors.non_circularity: Expected values are static specification literals copied by the generator; production normalize or closure functions never generate expected values.

required_classes: direct execution of occurrence-summary, context-v3 closure, and Option C semantic-acceptance literals
full audit artifacts and seal for each fixture
all applicable D4 and D5 production, model-boundary, and hostile-artifact attacks from EVALUATOR_SPEC.md section 11
fixture_policy.regeneration_rule: write_generated copies static vector literals and executes the real pipeline for generated run fixtures; evaluator generate-fixtures --check must reproduce every generated byte; evaluator run-attacks must apply each named production mutation or hostile input rather than count manifest rows; deleting text casefold must make T09/T15 fail

freeze_hashes.non_null_gate: After the Stage 0 driver is implemented and atomically re-sealed, all eight hashes and the manifest path must be non-null; SHA-256 of the exact manifest bytes must equal freeze_manifest_sha256, its bundle/execution hashes must equal the active slots, its supersedes_freeze_manifest_sha256 must equal the last freeze_history manifest hash, and verify-frozen must pass before status may return to frozen-before-corpus-resolution.

freeze_history.reason: Wave 3-5 independent review changed semantic acceptance to Option C; this pre-oracle freeze is retained as history and is not valid for Stage 0.
Wave 7 found that the normative specification still declared a two-input execution hash and 12 manifest keys while the frozen implementation used three inputs and 15 keys.
Hash-bound context.rs, generic.rs, and generic_v3.rs changed after the Wave 7 seal; generated files remained present and byte-identical, but the semantic workspace binding no longer matched.

The frozen bundle had per-cluster Stage 0 closure helpers but no production Stage 0 entrance, deterministic commit-cluster identity, complete output-root contract, or authenticated Stage 1 selection handoff; no Stage 0 or model result was observed.

Wave 19 made the three freeze-gate fixture cases self-contained and assigned artifact audit a unique temporary root; evaluator semantics and preregistered endpoints remained unchanged, and no Stage 0, model, or corpus outcome was observed.

Wave 21 corrected product-CLI Stage 0 execution to use repository-relative artifact paths in independent repository copies, external typed diagnostics, and the preregistered 20000-file ingest admission bound; no Stage 0, model, or corpus outcome was observed.

runtime_contract.mismatch_rule: A semantic runtime mismatch is verify-frozen exit 3 before pipeline launch, not a warning or arm zero. Provisioning the matching runtime preserves the study; changing this contract requires a new versioned study.
runtime_contract.provenance_rule: Exact executable hash and platform are recorded but excluded from evaluator_bundle_sha256 and evaluator_execution_sha256. Compatible provenance changes are allowed only after all frozen checks pass.

arm_neutral_contracts.change_rule: A normative evaluator-tree file change changes evaluator_bundle_sha256 and evaluator_execution_sha256. A semantic runtime-contract change changes evaluator_execution_sha256. A design-spec change changes its separately recorded manifest/protocol hash. Every normative post-freeze change requires a new versioned study; compatible observed executable/platform provenance changes none of these identities.

primary_endpoint.name: usable_grounded_disposition_completed(commit, arm)
primary_endpoint.normative_scorer: The m20-evaluator.pipeline.v2 bundle and semantic runtime contract jointly identified by evaluator_execution_sha256 after the required atomic reseal; the single in-process pipeline and EVALUATOR_SPEC.md sections 8-9 are the only scorer before registered Stage 1.
primary_endpoint.value_one: The generated m20.primary_score.v3 record has completed=true under the frozen evaluator. No prose reimplementation may rescore a cell.
forced_zero_classes: process, timeout, empty, parse, schema, closure, source-payload, policy, tool, truncation, or retained-hash failure
foreign/out-of-range source, inconclusive, non-substantive text, routine/mixed/asymmetric abstention opportunity
judge batch unavailable/invalid, candidate/hash/reverse-map mismatch, or utility threshold failure
primary_endpoint.missing_data_rule: After sealed launch, every missing or failed arm result is 0 with no retry.
primary_endpoint.interpretation: frozen usability-proxy completion only; not truth, verification, evidence support, or human acceptance

driver_contract.authority: hash-frozen evaluator production surface; no unfrozen scripts driver
driver_contract.output_root: caller-selected initially nonexistent destination; path is not an identity input; closed layout is corpus-manifest.v1.json, clusters/<commit-cluster digest>/build-1/, clusters/<commit-cluster digest>/build-2/, stage0-result.v1.json, stage0-selection.v1.json, and artifact-manifest.v1.json
driver_contract.commit_cluster_id: D(commit-cluster,{cluster_contract:m20.commit_cluster@1,experiment_id:m20-changed-public-callee-utility-v1,repository_id:canonical repository ID,base_commit_oid:exact Git object ID,head_commit_oid:exact Git object ID}) under frozen restricted canonical JSON
driver_contract.responsibilities: resolve and seal corpus; process every one of 300 clusters in two clean builds; evaluate exactly seven gates; derive and seal exact model-eligible hash order and first 10/40 cumulative membership; make zero model calls
driver_contract.ingest_admission: every Stage 0 product request sets ingest.max_files=20000, the closed v3 schema maximum and section 11 quickstart value; this is an admission/resource bound, not C/A/S/D membership: overflow is typed Stage 0 failure and cannot truncate accepted files, remove a cluster from C, or create model ineligibility; the separate materialized-source bound remains 4096
driver_contract.endpoint_separation: Stage 0 may only authorize/block launch and select exact IDs; its records contain no arm/model/judge/primary values and cannot enter scoring or n/b/c/n00; each later run authenticates the selection-manifest hash and membership
driver_contract.parallelism: cluster-level parallelism is allowed; worker ceiling=max(1,min(16,available logical CPUs-2)), with unavailable or <=2 CPUs yielding one; --jobs is a public operational argument constrained to 1..=ceiling, omitted means ceiling, and its value is excluded from every output, ID, manifest, hash, gate, and selection input; each worker owns one cluster with two isolated clean builds
driver_contract.freeze_gate: before corpus resolution or output-root creation, load preregistration.json, require all active hashes and manifest path non-null, and require verify-frozen ok=true; otherwise refuse without repository observation
driver_contract.parallel_determinism: final reduction is sorted only by commit_cluster_id UTF-8 bytes; one-worker, computed-ceiling, and reversed-completion tests must produce byte-identical complete output trees and identical artifact/selection hashes
driver_contract.timing: wall time, per-cluster process CPU time, peak bytes, worker count/utilization, PID, host, and scheduling order may appear only in diagnostics outside the closed output root; they are not gates, canonical values, manifest members, hash inputs, or selection inputs

exact_sets.C: exact sorted set of all 300 commit-cluster IDs, including zero-obligation clusters
exact_sets.A_c: for each c in C, exact sorted substantive D obligation IDs whose applicability is applicable after rust.production.v1 exclusions; excluded, target-support-unknown, and rule-gap IDs are not members
exact_sets.A: exact union of all A_c; snapshot-bound IDs make cluster sets disjoint
exact_sets.S_c: exact subset of A_c whose selected packet admits both exact caller and exact callee subject windows, each closing to its required source ID and full subject span
exact_sets.S: exact union of all S_c; every ID in A\S has a typed subject_loss or subject_unknown record with source and recovery reference, never a profile exclusion
exact_sets.D_c: for each c in C, exact subset of A_c whose plan status is deferred
exact_sets.D: exact union of all D_c; deferred fraction is zero if A is empty, while prevalence separately fails

gates.pass: at least 45 of 300 A_c sets are nonempty and |A|>=60
median admitted bytes <=0.50*median whole changed production-file bytes over A packets and nearest-rank p90 admitted bytes <=65536; even median is midpoint average

two clean rebuilds match obligation, universe, source, applicability, context.subject_windows@3 four-denominator commitments/subject outcomes/anchor partitions, inventory, loss, occurrence summaries/count/digest/coverage, and canonical bytes for all clusters

direct_calls=partial, one source-backed global unknown-latent limitation, exact enumeration_obstruction_summary_ids and enumeration_limitation_ids with their exact union enumeration_obstruction_ids, observed occurrence count/digest, and the D rule-level gap remain visible for every repository snapshot; no complete-call claim and no located_call_occurrences rows
sort all 300 (c,|A_c|) by (|A_c|,c), including zeros; 1-indexed nearest-rank p95 index 285 <=50

stage_0.occurrence_record_shape: one exact source_occurrence_summary per accepted Rust file with observed occurrences, plus report/rule count and sorted occurrence-ID-set SHA-256; spans and owner source IDs are typed omitted_rebuildable detail, not deleted observations
stage_0.occurrence_operational_measurement: Canonical Stage 0 retains deterministic report bytes, summary rows, and observed occurrences only. The pre-seal 183.2-second per-cluster observation implies about 15.3 serial hours for 300 clusters; wall time, per-cluster process CPU time, peak bytes, and parallelism are external noncanonical diagnostics and never gate or selection inputs. The rejected row shape would retain 96329400 individual records.
stage_0.context_v3_shape: accepted/reached/materialized/support-anchor domains each retain known count plus sorted-ID-set SHA-256; only subject-file IDs union reached-file IDs materialize, subject outcomes are callee then caller, and uncovered known anchors close through at most 15 exact reason summaries
stage_0.failure: Any gate failure stops all model execution, is slice failure, and is not feasibility success; no cap, drop, weight change, count-only surrogate, or post-result filter may simulate a pass.

control_labels.timing: Both labels and rationales for every model-eligible commit are sealed before any arm outcome.
control_labels.membership_effect: none; labels cannot alter the fixed public-hash membership or order regardless of whether labelers know a candidate's public rank

rubric.clean_refactor_control: source inspection affirmatively supports semantics-preserving/refactor-only change and no caller-visible precondition, postcondition, error-path, or return-meaning change; cite exact hunks
rubric.not_control: source supports a caller-visible semantic change or does not affirmatively establish clean/refactor

control_labels.adjudication: two clean labels form a control; disagreement, unable, or missing is unresolved and remains primary
control_labels.insufficient: primary cells remain reportable but advance/final success is blocked

secondary_endpoints.same_judge_batch: The same one-per-commit two-candidate batch may emit a separately labeled defect projection after both primary utility records; it remains secondary.
measures: issue_should_be_created commits by arm and among agreed controls
usable completions and defect-positive commits per 1000 observed reviewer-model seconds
usable completions per admitted source byte and total serialized packet byte
timeout, parse failure, claim/abstention counts, source/total bytes, observation-only backend-reported tokens, truncation, and wall time
secondary_endpoints.authority: non-authority descriptive proxy only; never defect truth and never able to rescue primary completion or a rectangle

stage_1.advance_requires: all seven Stage 0 gates, primary rectangle, all repository/leave-one-out cells, backend/leakage integrity, all primary judge batches, >=2 controls, and safety gate

stage_2A.success_requires: Stage 1 advanced, cumulative rectangle, all repository/leave-one-out cells, backend/leakage integrity, all primary judge batches, >=8 controls, and safety gate

safety_gate.failure: judge-positive agreed-control count in B > corresponding A count + 1
safety_gate.meaning: small-sample safety stop, not powered non-inferiority

backend_gate.rule: reacquire identity/health before each stage and reviewer invocation; prelaunch failure stops without imputation, postlaunch failure is 0

realized_cost_audit.deterministic_budget: seal budget.json with each packet hash, admitted-source byte count, <=65536 result, pair eligibility, and content-derived audit ID; verify-run recomputes it from the two sealed packets
realized_cost_audit.per_launched_arm: seal exact serialized packet and component bytes; observation-only backend tokenizer/usage data or typed unavailable; truncation; output bytes; raw/parsed hashes
realized_cost_audit.token_observation: closed observation_only record; never independently recomputed, compared with a ceiling, or used as authority
realized_cost_audit.client_truncation: forbidden; no tokenizer preflight exists; admitted-source byte overflow produces the pair-wide sealed model_ineligible terminal result before sampling or calls
realized_cost_audit.provider_truncation_or_context_rejection: after an eligible request is sent, postlaunch primary 0 without retry

freeze_and_seal.freeze_point: independent executable evaluator bundle including its Stage 0 driver, Option C oracle/reference/mutants, measurements, and these five design files freeze before Stage 0, model observation, corpus resolution, repository identities, or ranges
freeze_and_seal.before_stage_0: verify non-null evaluator bundle/execution/fixture/vector/mutation/semantic-reference/measurement hashes and runtime manifest on the exact semantic runtime contract, then seal implementation/protocol/profile/context/repository manifests
freeze_and_seal.after_stage_0: seal builds, exact C/A/S/D sets, all seven gates, boundary fixtures, and model eligibility
freeze_and_seal.before_each_model_stage: seal all eligible labels/rationales, label-independent sample, evaluator-generated A/B packets, payload/inventory closure, deterministic source-byte budget records, observation-only token schema, backend and arm order
freeze_and_seal.before_primary_judging: within the same run, write-only seal both raw/parsed outputs, usage/truncation, generated packet hashes, per-arm hidden bindings, judge permutation, opaque candidate IDs, and reverse-map hash; continue from original in-memory values without rereading artifacts
freeze_and_seal.before_disclosure: seal primary judge/scorer records, cells, sensitivities, safety counts, and decision
freeze_and_seal.repair: any repair creates a new versioned study and cannot replace a frozen result
freeze_and_seal.pre_stage1_packet_amendment: Before registered Stage 1, atomically reseal the shared change-evidence packet contract and rerun Stage 0; this construct-validity repair changes neither the frozen primary endpoint/thresholds nor the retained 12000-token/900-second model budget and cannot reinterpret any earlier observation as a registered result

interpretation_limits: Open development on one machine/Unix identity; commitments are procedural, not access separation or organizational blindness.
Adjacent commits and findings are dependent; rectangles are frozen-corpus descriptive gates only.
The primary judge is a frozen non-authority usability proxy and a source of correlated model dependence, not defect truth.
No population precision/recall, general Rust utility, significance, or holdout validity.
The study enforces an equal 65536-byte admitted-source ceiling, not an equal token budget; token counts may differ between arms and any backend reports are descriptive observations only.
direct_calls is partial; accepted edges do not generalize to all callers.
